description: An hour each way, five days, forty-six weeks is about 460 hours - roughly eleven and a half working weeks a year, unpaid.
energy_note: Three months of working days, given away.

aspect: Housing and commute trade against each other
description: Cheaper housing is further out, so the rent saving is paid in hours - which means whoever has least money travels most.

aspect: Delays are not yours to fix
description: A cancelled train or a closed road is somebody else's failure, absorbed by you, with the lateness attributed to you.
energy_note: Blamed for a decision made by a signal box.
